name: Aku'mai
summary: At Blackfathom Deeps, Aku'mai haunts the sunken temple of Elune along the Zoram Strand. An Old God's corruption tainted its sacred Moon Well, and Aku'mai rose from the waters as the Old God's servant. The Twilight's Hammer sacrifices innocents to Aku'mai for power.

sections.title: The Scourge of Zoram Strand
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps was once a great temple of Elune. Then an Old God's corruption tainted its sacred Moon Well, and Aku'mai rose from the waters. The gargantuan hydra serves the Old God. Now Aku'mai lairs in the drowned ruins of the night elves' temple, poisoning the waters along the Zoram Strand with its malice.

sections.title: Servant of the Primordial Darkness
sections.body: Aku'mai's presence drew the Twilight's Hammer into the subterranean caverns. Twilight Lord Kelris leads the cultists, who have joined with the naga to occupy the drowned temple. There, they sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power.

aliases: what kind of monster is akumai
faq.answer: Aku'mai is an ancient hydra with three heads, serving an Old God. It rose from the tainted waters of Blackfathom Deeps and lairs in the temple's submerged halls.
Aku'mai lives in the submerged grottos of Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined temple of Elune along the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer feeding Aku'mai?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer reveres Aku'mai as a servant of the Old Gods. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for dark power.
Aku'mai is immense, with multiple snapping heads, and bears the dark favor of the Old Gods. In battle, it rages and engulfs those nearby in clouds of poison.
No. Aku'mai is a primordial hydra that serves an Old God. Its evil presence drew the Twilight's Hammer to worship around it.

faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the deeps to slay it?
faq.answer: If left unchecked, Aku'mai's savagery and the cult's devotion threaten to unleash calamitous evil across Ashenvale and Kalimdor. Alliance and Horde authorities seek to end the Twilight's Hammer and slay the horror in the heart of the temple.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Aku'mai defiling the deepest sanctorum of a ruined temple once consecrated to Elune. A holy site has become a lair of corruption.
As a priest, you see Aku'mai and the Twilight's Hammer embody the Old Gods' corruption, set against the teachings of the Holy Light and Elune.
As a druid, you see Aku'mai's unnatural corruption warping Ashenvale's coastal waters. They must be cleansed to restore natural balance.
